**Job Title: Systems Technologist – Industrial Control Systems****Job Description**This role focuses on designing, programming, and implementing industrial control and automation solutions for heavy industrial environments. You will work on large machinery and complex process systems, combining control system design, PLC programming, HMI development, and on-site commissioning support. The position offers exposure to cutting-edge automation projects, significant problem-solving opportunities, and the chance to contribute directly to innovative integration work in a collaborative and growth-oriented team.  

**Responsibilities**

- Design, program, and implement industrial control systems for heavy industrial, mining, and process plant environments.
- Develop PLC programs from scratch, including rewriting and optimizing large portions of existing code when issues arise.
- Troubleshoot complex automation and control system problems and provide effective, timely solutions.
- Configure, program, and maintain PLCs, particularly Schneider platforms, to support industrial automation projects.
- Develop and maintain HMI applications using tools such as Wonderware, FactoryTalk, and Ignition.
- Work with variable frequency drives (VFDs), especially ABB VFDs, to integrate and control large machinery.
- Apply and adhere to the Canadian Electrical Code in all aspects of electrical design and implementation.
- Assist with electrical design and control panel layouts, leveraging CAD software where applicable.
- Participate in on-site work at customer facilities, including commissioning, testing, and resolving client issues.
- Collaborate with electricians, mechanical engineers, and other technical teams to deliver integrated automation solutions.
- Create and maintain project documentation, including design specifications, programming notes, and test reports.
- Contribute to project management activities, such as planning tasks, tracking progress, and coordinating with stakeholders.
- Engage in open discussions about workload and project responsibilities to align work with individual strengths and interests.
- Handle difficult situations professionally and maintain a solutions-oriented mindset when facing complex challenges.
- Support continuous improvement efforts in control systems, automation processes, and team practices.

**Essential Skills**

- Diploma in Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, Mechatronics, or a closely related discipline.
- Minimum 3 years of direct experience in industrial, mining, or process plant environments.
- At least 3 years of PLC programming experience, including hands-on work with Schneider PLCs.
- Demonstrated ability to create PLC programs from scratch and to rewrite substantial portions of code when required.
- Minimum 2 years of experience developing and working with HMIs such as Wonderware, FactoryTalk, and Ignition.
- At least 3 years of experience working with VFDs, preferably ABB VFDs, in industrial applications.
- Minimum 2 years of on-site experience working directly with clients in industrial settings.
- At least 3 years of experience working with and applying the Canadian Electrical Code.
- Strong troubleshooting skills and the ability to solve complex control and automation problems.
- Comfort working with heavy industrial automation and large machinery, including on-site commissioning and testing.
- Ability to work collaboratively with multidisciplinary teams, including electricians and mechanical engineers.
- Clear, professional communication skills for interacting with clients and internal stakeholders.

**Additional Skills & Qualifications**

- Professional engineering designation (P.Eng.) or Engineer-in-Training (EIT) status is an asset.
- Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or a related engineering discipline is an asset.
- 5+ years of experience programming and troubleshooting PLCs is preferred.
- 2+ years of experience working with CAD software for electrical design and control panel layouts is an asset.
- Project management experience, including planning, coordination, and documentation, is beneficial.
- Experience with radar-based automation or advanced sensing technologies is an asset.
- Interest in continuous learning and professional development, including pursuing additional training or education.
- Ability to thrive in a fast-growing, evolving environment with changing project demands.
- Strong problem-solving mindset, with a genuine interest in tackling complex technical challenges rather than routine tasks.

**Work Environment**The role combines office-based design and programming work with regular on-site activities at customer facilities. On a typical week, you may spend approximately three out of five days in the office and two days on customer sites, working on programming, CAD design, documentation, commissioning, and testing. Occasionally, large projects may require extended on-site presence, such as up to three weeks in a row, a few times per year. The team environment is energetic, and highly collaborative, with colleagues actively supporting each other and engaging in open conversations about responsibilities and career goals. The culture encourages personal growth, with training and further education supported and funded, allowing you to tailor your development path and gain experience across different areas of automation and control. The atmosphere is friendly and informal, with social activities such as board games at lunch contributing to a positive and engaging workplace. Overtime is compensated at a premium rate and can be banked as time off or taken as additional pay, providing flexibility in how you manage your work-life balance.  

**Job Type & Location**This is a Contract to Hire position based out of Port Coqutilam, BC.  

**Pay And Benefits**The pay range for this position is $45.00 - $51.00/hr.  

Individual compensation offered for this position within this range will depend on many factors, including qualifications, skills, relevant experience, job knowledge, geographic location, internal equity, and other pertinent job-related factors.  

**Workplace Type**This is a hybrid position in Port Coqutilam,BC.  

À propos d'Actalent  

Actalent est un leader mondial dans les services d’ingénierie et de sciences ainsi que dans les solutions de talents. Nous aidons des entreprises visionnaires à faire progresser leurs initiatives d’ingénierie et de science grâce à l’accès à des experts spécialisés qui favorisent l’échelle, l’innovation et la rapidité de mise sur le marché. Avec un réseau de près de 20 000 consultants et 5 000 clients à travers les États-Unis, le Canada, l’Asie et l’Europe, Actalent dessert de nombreuses entreprises du Fortune 500. Nous sommes fiers d’être l’une des 500 meilleures firmes de conception de l’Engineering News-Record (ENR) pour nos services de conception en ingénierie et un lauréat du prix ClearlyRated Best of Staffing® tant pour le service client que pour les talents.  

Actalent est un employeur souscrivant au principe de l’égalité des chances et accepte toutes les candidatures sans tenir compte de la race, du sexe, de l’âge, de la couleur, de la religion, des origines nationales, du statut d’ancien combattant, d’un handicap, de l’orientation sexuelle, de l’identité sexuelle, des renseignements génétiques ou de toute autre caractéristique protégée par la loi.

sample.title: Control Systems Technologist

sample.description:
**What's In It For You****Benefits:**

- Compensation: $42.31 to $58.17 CAD per hour
- Annual Performance-Based Incentive Bonus
- 5% RRSP match
- Stock purchase plan
- Starting 3 weeks of vacation
- Benefits package (health and dental) + $600 health spending account
- Half-Day Fridays
- Working on challenging engineering projects.
- Continuous learning and career growth with global mobility opportunities.
- A chance to contribute to something bigger - advancing the future of healthcare through automation.

**Job Description**MAJOR DUTIES:  

As a member of a highly motivated, dynamic, multi-disciplined team, you will design and develop world-class automation solutions. Duties involve  

- Planning and leading projects including oversight of a project team
- Responsible for project tracking, project milestones and project budget for assigned project including attending project team meetings
- Contributing to machine concepts
- Design of control software
- Integration of software with electrical and mechanical systems
- Mentoring more junior members of the controls team
- Process development and machine installation at customer sites worldwide
- Programming and integration assignments involve leading-edge technologies and processes utilizing PLC’s, PC’s, robotics, motion controllers, vision systems, laser and other controllers.

SPECIFIC RESPONSIBILITIES:  

- Complete yearly assigned department objectives
- Design and develop software programs (PLC and/or PC based) specific to customer and project requirements based on standard ATS programming methods.
- Debug and commission control systems at our facility, during the system integration stage and then at the customer’s site during installation.
- Travel as required to customer and supplier sites to perform installation, commissioning and training duties.
- Select, test and integrate hardware and software components such as robots, analog devices, motion controllers, sensors, vision systems and lasers.
- Work with other members of the control systems design department and other groups to continuously improve methods of integrating controls technology, with the goals being enhanced safety, enhanced functionality and reduced cost.
- Work with other members of the control systems design department and other groups to ensure that labor and material budgets as well as scheduled delivery dates are adhered to or improved upon.
- Work with customers, project managers, designers, toolmakers and electricians to solve problems in order to provide the customer with a complete, functional automation system.
- Provide thorough testing of machine functionality to verify software program completeness.
- Provide accurate documentation for each project.
- Advise customer on solving technical problems.
- Provide customer with training specific to their current project (i.e. machine operation, programming principles and program structure).
- These responsibilities are subject to change as a function of the individual’s abilities.
- Improve the knowledge and capability of other members of the engineering department through mentoring.
- Responsible to work with leader on development plan, updating Skills/Training Matrix and attending 1:1 meetings.
- Responsible for advancing self-knowledge, and demonstrating the use of a variety of ABM tools including but not limited to: PDCA, Formal Problem Solving (A3, RCCA), Kaizen, Just-Do-It CIs, 5S, 8W, Visual Management (Control Boards)
- Responsible for meeting Team Member level KPIs as assigned. (Budget, Schedule, Quality, CI)
- Assist with the Team Leader’s responsibilities during their absence and periodically supervise the software development and integration effort on at a team level delegating tasks to a team of people.
- Responsible for communicating time estimates and resource requirements on controls tasks to the Team Leader and at times the Project managers.

**Additional Responsibilities**

- At times will be asked to periodically assist with:

- Participate/lead in the concepting and requirements definition of a project with the FEOTB team.
- Develop and verify concept and labour hour’s budget in quote preparation.
- Provide expert judgment and expertise in the oversight and review of technical projects.
- Lead technical evaluation of significant technologies in their area of expertise, and sign off on project designs
- Provide engineering support to ATS’ worldwide divisions.
- Provide technical assistance to the rest of the department for area of expertise.
- Will assist in developing design and department standards.
- Oversees Co-op students
- Ensure that the concepts and design of customer solutions maximizes the use of standard code.
- Lead or participate in design reviews with customers, vendors and internal design groups.
- Assist with continuous improvement efforts within the department.

- Ensure that all business activities are performed with the highest ethical standards and in compliance with the ATS Code of Business Conduct.

**Qualifications**Education:  

- A post-secondary engineering degree, diploma or equivalent, specializing in mechanical, electrical, systems or computer engineering.

Experience:  

- Strong programming, mechanical and electrical problem-solving skills.
- Ability to communicate effectively, both orally and in writing.
- Understanding of robotics, control systems and machine operation with hands-on experience is desirable.
- A self-starter with the ability to work as part of a team in a fast-paced environment with minimal supervision.

Health, Safety & Environmental  

All employees have the responsibility to work in a safe manner and report any health, safety or environmental concern to their manager or supervisor in a timely manner.  

**Health, Safety and Environment include:**

- Work in compliance with divisional health, safety and environmental procedures
- Refrain from removing or altering safety devices or guarding unless hazardous energies are controlled through lockout-tagout methods
- Report any unsafe conditions or unsafe acts
- Report defect in any equipment or protective device
- Ensure that the required protective equipment is used for the assigned tasks
- Attend all required health, safety and environmental training
- Report any accidents/incidents to supervisor
- Assist in investigating accidents/incidents
- Refrain from engaging in any prank, contest, feat of strength, unnecessary running or rough and boisterous conduct

sample.description:
Clio is the global leader in legal AI technology, empowering legal professionals and law firms of every size to work smarter, faster, and more securely.  

We are transforming the legal experience for all by bettering the lives of legal professionals while increasing access to justice.  

**Summary:**Clio is more than just a tech company–we are a pioneer in legal technology with a mission to transform the legal experience for all. We empower legal professionals with innovative solutions that make legal work more efficient, seamless, and effective, contributing to increased access to justice.  

Summary:  

Clio is transforming client intake, marketing, and growth strategies for law firms with Clio Grow. Our vision for Clio Grow is to become the best CRM platform for Legal. We are seeking a passionate and driven Senior Product Manager to join our Clio Grow team and help shape the future of how law firms attract, retain, and engage clients.  

Attracting new and returning clients is essential to running a successful law practice. As a Senior Product Manager for Clio Grow, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the vision, strategy, and execution of the product roadmap, with a focus on enhancing Clio Grow’s client intake (e.g. screening leads, booking consultations, etc. You will lead the development of AI tools that empower law firms to capture leads, screen them for firm fit and book them for consultations. This role requires a deep understanding of customer needs, close collaboration with cross-functional teams, and a commitment to driving measurable impact for law firms of all sizes.  

Your proven product management skills will be critical to shaping the trajectory of new products and features, as well as driving integrations with external products and partners. You will be responsible for ensuring the product evolves to meet the needs of legal professionals, maintaining its competitive edge while delivering meaningful value to our customers and their clients.  

What You'll Work On  

- Product Leadership: As a Senior Product Manager you will drive successful outputs and outcomes in your product area. Working from the overarching strategy set by your Director you will develop a roadmap in conjunction with your peers that moves our business forward and evangelize this throughout the company.
- Drive AI-Powered Innovation: Use your domain expertise to envision how AI-driven automation can radically simplify how lawyers intake new clients from first outreach to signed agreements.
- Champion Product-Led Growth: You will lead with intuitive onboarding and automation solutions to make getting started and managing leads "dramatically easier," thereby driving user adoption and business growth.
- Strategy and Prioritization: You will drive customer and market research, identify opportunities, develop unbiased business cases, and determine priorities that will help Clio best deliver on our mission and against our annual OKRs. You will build conviction in the initiatives that you choose to invest in and be willing to pivot when priorities change or new information comes to light.
- Cross-Functional Leadership: Ship and launch features end-to-end, collaborating with cross-functional teams like Development, Product Design, Marketing, Sales, and Support

What You Bring  

- Prior Experience in Legal or Legal tech: A background as a practicing lawyer, in a legal operations role or building AI-powered technology solutions is a significant asset. You should have a clear understanding of legal document standards, discovery processes, and litigation workflows.
- Product Management Acumen: At least 6 years of product management experience in a SaaS or B2B software environment. This includes a proven track record of owning and shipping mission-critical products at scale.
- Experience with AI-Driven Products: Proven experience building or managing AI-driven products, with a strong understanding of how to leverage machine learning capabilities to solve real user problems.
- Execution and Ownership: You are an outcomes-obsessed leader with a proven ability to make things happen, owning products throughout their lifecycle.
- Strategic & Data-Driven Thinking: You are a visionary who uses both qualitative and quantitative data to drive product strategy, defining requirements and measuring impact. You are comfortable with ambiguity and have a strong track record of making decisions under uncertainty.
- Customer-Focused Mindset: Keeps the customer at the center of decision-making, delivering high-impact features that users love while bringing curiosity and a willingness to learn what drives their needs.
- Collaborative, Detail-Oriented: Partners effectively with Product, Design, and Engineering teams, ensuring requirements are clear and aligned with product vision while managing multiple priorities without compromising quality or timelines.
- Strong Communicator: Communicates effectively with cross-functional teams and stakeholders, with the humility to seek guidance and adapt in a fast-paced environment.

Product at Clio  

Our market opportunity is rare in its scale and powered by a strong business model, Silicon Valley based investors and advisors and a product management team which is global and world-class (if we do say so ourselves)! Clio is growing rapidly with massive growth opportunities for Product Managers.  

Speaking of *product a*t Clio… we’ve worked hard to develop an excellent product management culture with empowered PMs who are highly regarded and influential within the organization. Our team is composed of seasoned professionals from a diverse set of product backgrounds. Clio invests heavily in developing Product Managers, growing leaders and in the broader Product communities in which we operate.  

We pride ourselves on being ‘human and high performing’ and creating a workplace where you can be challenged, supported and bring your whole self to work.  

This role is a backfill for an existing position.  

**What you will find here:**Compensation is one of the main components of Clio’s Total Rewards Program. We have developed a series of programs and processes to ensure we are creating fair and competitive pay practices that form the foundation of our human and high-performing culture.  

**Some highlights of our Total Rewards program include:**

- Competitive, equitable salary with top-tier health benefits, dental, and vision insurance
- Hybrid work environment, with expectation for local Clions (Vancouver, Calgary, Toronto, Dublin, London, New York City and Sydney) to be in office min. twice per week.
- Flexible time off policy, with an encouraged 20 days off per year.
- $2000 annual counseling benefit
- RRSP matching and RESP contribution
- Clioversary recognition program with special acknowledgement at 3, 5, 7, and 10 years

The expected salary range for this role is $137,500 to $186,100 CAD. Initial placement within the range is informed by geographic region, experience, and skillset, with room to progress as impact and tenure grow. Final offer amounts will vary based on candidate profile.  

**Diversity, Inclusion, Belonging and Equity (DIBE) & Accessibility**Our team shows up as their authentic selves, and are united by our mission. We are dedicated to diversity, equity and inclusion. We pride ourselves in building and fostering an environment where our teams feel included, valued, and enabled to do the best work of their careers, wherever they choose to log in from. We believe that different perspectives, skills, backgrounds, and experiences result in higher-performing teams and better innovation. We are committed to equal employment and we encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.  

Clio provides accessibility accommodations during the recruitment process. Should you require any accommodation, please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs.  

Learn more about our culture at clio.com/careers  

We're a Human and High Performing AI company, meaning we use artificial intelligence to improve all of our operations. In recruitment, AI helps us streamline the process for greater efficiency. However, we've built our systems to ensure that a human always reviews AI-generated output, and we never make automated hiring decisions.  

***Disclaimer:** We only communicate with candidates through official @clio.com email addresses.*

**Position overview**

The Phantom Squad is an enabling team focused on solving some of the most complex challenges at the browser and infrastructure level. Their work underpins Stay22’s ability to deliver high-performance, privacy-conscious, and scalable embedded experiences. From optimizing DOM injection and session persistence to advancing fingerprinting and iframe lifecycle management, Phantom enables product-facing teams to build with confidence and speed.

As a Senior Technical Product Manager, you will shape and drive the strategy behind these low-level capabilities—turning technical potential into product-enabling power. A key focus area will be the evolution of Deep22, our initiative to build robust scraping pipelines and fallback data sources that improve affiliate data completeness, deeplinking accuracy, and partner integration performance. Your work will directly impact monetization opportunities, script reliability, and user experience across Stay22’s suite of products.

You’ll collaborate with expert engineers to explore the boundaries of browser behaviour and work across teams to ensure these technical foundations serve real-world product needs at scale.

**Key responsibilities**

- Perform Research, including user research, technology assessment and market analysis to identify new opportunities.
- Align and coordinate with stakeholders to identify and prioritize pain points to unlock new paths to partner success and monetization.
- Partner with engineers to explore and define the future of fingerprinting, DOM injection, and browser behavior optimization, with an emphasis on privacy, scalability, and reliability
- Own Phantom’s technical strategy and roadmap, aligning it with cross-squad priorities and the company's objectives and key stakeholders.
- Gather and synthesize user requirements from research and internal stakeholders (internal product teams, engineers, business teams, marketing, finance, etc.)
- Define success metrics, own Phantom’s impact measurement, and communicate its value across Stay22.
- Collaborate in Go-to-market activities with Product Marketing.
- Keep pace with fast-changing browser and privacy standards and ensure our tech stack remains resilient and compliant

**Requirements**

- 5+ years as a Product Manager, ideally 3+ years in a Technical PM role (experience with technical infrastructure, developer tools, or browser-level technologies).
- Strong technical fluency—you can comfortably translate complex engineering concepts into product implications and vice versa.
- Experience collaborating with deeply technical teams, especially in environments requiring cross-team enablement or shared service delivery.
- Capability to react fast to shifting priorities to meet business needs.
- Strong analytical skills and the ability to use both quantitative and qualitative insights to drive decision-making.
- Clear, concise communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
- Passion for problem-solving in ambiguous and evolving spaces—especially where innovation, performance, and privacy intersect

**What to Expect from our Hiring Process**

We know your time’s valuable, so here’s the quick rundown of what to expect.

1. Screening call with our Talent Acquisition Partner (20-30min)
2. Interview with the Head of Product (45min)
3. Technical take-home & virtual discussion (60min of discussion)
4. In person panel Interview with the Product & Engineering team (60min)
5. Final interview with our CEO (30min)
6. Offer & onboarding

*🎉Please note that this process is subject to change at any point, based on additional requirements from the team.*

**Why join Stay22?**

- **Prime Montreal Location:** Work from our vibrant Little Italy HQ with a cafeteria allowance, full gym access, and a rooftop terrace complete with a seasonal basketball/pickleball court & hockey rink.
- **Comprehensive Benefits:** Health & dental coverage, RRSP matching, fully paid STM pass’, and regular team socials, events, and retreats.
- **Flexibility That Works:** Flexible schedules, work-from-anywhere opportunities, year-end shutdown, and flex days

*(Stay22 is an equal-opportunity employer. All qualified applicants are given consideration. If you have a disability or particular need that requires accommodation, please contact us at careers@stay22.cmo)*

**Product Manager, Hardware, Wearables, IOT.**

**Position Type:** Permanent

**Work Arrangement:** Hybrid (3 days in office)

**About the Opportunity**

Join a dynamic, forward-thinking organization undergoing a major transformation to become a global leader in performance, customer care, and sustainability within the aviation and transport sector.

Working alongside a team of dedicated professionals, you will help shape a next-generation travel ecosystem. We innovate across every touchpoint to deliver safe, uplifting, and seamless experiences for passengers while driving long-term value for our employees, local community, and industry partners.

**What We Offer**

- **Growth & Development:** Excellent opportunities to advance your career within a high-impact, rapidly evolving environment alongside passionate team members.
- **Competitive Compensation & Benefits:** A comprehensive benefits package, including flexible retirement programs with employer matching and multiple voluntary savings options.
- **Work-Life Integration:** Hybrid working arrangements, continuous internal and external learning programs, and a dedicated reward and recognition initiative.

**Position Overview**

Reporting to the Associate Director of Product Management, the **Product Manager, Hardware Operations** plays a critical role in driving our digital transformation strategy. You will lead the vision, strategy, and execution of digital products designed to optimize operational efficiency and elevate the passenger journey.

In this role, you will lead a dedicated, cross-functional product team, translating complex operational requirements and customer insights into secure, highly reliable digital solutions. You will define value hypotheses, prioritize feature backlogs, guide product discovery, and ensure delivery excellence across the full product lifecycle.

**Key Responsibilities**

- **Vision & Strategy:** Define and execute the product vision, roadmap, and measurable success metrics aligned with broader business and journey objectives.
- **Product Discovery:** Conduct discovery with internal stakeholders, frontline operational teams, and external vendors to identify key opportunities, mitigate risks, and gain actionable insights.
- **Requirements & Backlog Management:** Translate operational and customer feedback into detailed product specifications, epics, and user stories. Manage an integrated backlog balancing feature delivery, technical debt, security, and user experience.
- **Performance & Analytics:** Track key product performance metrics and health indicators, utilizing data-driven insights to guide ongoing optimization.
- **Delivery & Governance:** Coordinate release planning with tech delivery teams to ensure cross-functional readiness. Partner with IT Security, Enterprise Architecture, and domain experts to maintain compliance and risk posture.
- **Stakeholder Alignment:** Facilitate product updates, portfolio reviews, and stakeholder alignment sessions.
- **Team Leadership:** Build a collaborative, agile culture focused on rapid experimentation and continuous improvement.

**Qualifications & Experience**

- **Experience:** 5+ years of progressive experience in digital product management, with a proven track record of launching successful products within the airline or airport sectors (specific experience with airport operations software is strongly preferred).
- **Leadership:** 3+ years leading cross-functional teams, with strong capabilities in vendor management and influencing stakeholders without direct authority.
- **Technical & Design Depth:** Deep understanding of digital platforms, APIs, systems integration, UX design principles, and customer journey mapping within complex operational environments.
- **Frameworks:** Hands-on experience applying design-thinking frameworks to define problem statements, validate hypotheses, and build high-value solutions.
- **Communication:** Exceptional communication, storytelling, and workshop facilitation skills.
- **Tooling:** Proficiency with modern product management software (e.g., Jira, ProductPlan/Roadmunk, Figma/Miro) and product analytics tools.
- **Education & Certifications:** Bachelor’s degree in Business, Technology, Engineering, or a related field. Agile product management certifications (e.g., CSPO, Pragmatic Framework, SAFe) are an asset.
- **Security Clearances:** Ability to obtain and maintain the required Transportation Security Clearance level for the role.

Amazon Prime members are at the heart of Amazon’s tremendous growth. At the core of Prime’s success are products we are building to grow the customer base.

Key job responsibilities

**As a Senior Product Manager, Your Role Will Include**

- Technical Direction: Align on business priorities and technical direction for your product surface, and translate that into specs engineering can execute against.
- Founder Partnership: Work directly with the Head of Product and Engineering leadership on the architecture tradeoffs that determine the product's trajectory.
- Hands-on Validation: Run alpha and beta builds yourself. Catch integration issues before customers do.
- Customer Intelligence: Engage directly with platform engineers at AI Cloud operators, regulated enterprises, and large internal platform teams. The next zero-to-one comes from these conversations.
- Market Positioning: Track the cloud-native ecosystem and emerging tenancy primitives. Sharpen the narrative for technical buyers and partner with GTM on messaging that lands.
- Cross-Functional Leadership: Bridge engineering, sales, and marketing so what we ship matches how we sell and support it.

- Experience: 5+ years in product management, in cloud infrastructure, platform services, or distributed systems. You've shipped something other engineers depend on in production.
- Kubernetes Fluency: You have working knowledge of Kubernetes, how clusters, workloads, and namespaces fit together.
- Customer-Facing Infra Experience: You've sat across from platform engineers and architects, and you're comfortable in that conversation.

**Bonus Points For**

- Kubernetes-as-a-Service: Built a KaaS offering at a cloud provider, vendor, or large internal platform team.
- AI & MLOps Infrastructure: GPU scheduling, multi-tenant accelerator workloads, LLM deployment patterns.
- Internal Developer Platforms: Platform PM experience building IDPs that abstract infrastructure complexity for developer teams.
- Startup Growth: Adaptable to startup pace and change.

**About VCluster Labs**We're the #1 platform for AI infrastructure, trusted by the world's fastest-growing AI cloud builders. We're a venture-backed startup that's raised over $28M from top-tier investors including Khosla Ventures (first investor in OpenAI, GitLab, Stripe, and DoorDash), and we're in a hyper-growth phase looking for motivated people to join our team. Our headquarters are in San Francisco (Salesforce Tower), but our team is distributed around the globe with a remote-first culture.  

We give AI Cloud providers and AI factories a hyperscaler-like experience on their own GPU infrastructure. Our platform runs the full stack an operator needs, from bare metal provisioning and node lifecycle management up through managed Kubernetes, Slurm, Ray, and inference clusters, so they can turn raw GPUs into cluster products they can sell in days instead of spending 12+ months building it themselves. Today we power over 100,000 GPUs and 1 million CPUs across 50+ AI clouds and Fortune 500 companies, backed by a team of 40+ infrastructure engineers who build alongside our customers rather than just shipping them software.  

We're the company behind vCluster, the open source technology for tenant isolation on Kubernetes, with 11,000+ GitHub stars and 40M+ tenant clusters created since 2021. Open source is part of our DNA. At KubeCon North America 2025, we launched our Infrastructure Tenancy Platform for AI, a Kubernetes-native framework built for running AI, ML, and GPU-intensive workloads anywhere, with an NVIDIA-validated reference architecture for DGX systems.  

**Benefits**We offer the following benefits:  

- Competitive Salary: We offer a competitive compensation package, including equity.
- Platinum-Level Insurance: Health, dental, vision, and life Insurance, including plans for you and eligible dependents (benefits vary depending on country).
- Flexible Working Schedule: You have a doctor’s appointment or need to head to the supermarket to get groceries at 2pm? We won’t have an issue with that. To us, results matter more than clocking in and out at the same time every day.
- Workplace Flexibility: We’re very flexible about where you work. We know things can change in life and we’re happy to adjust the work environment for you along the way.

**Culture & Values****At VCluster Labs, We Value And Stand For**

- Make it Happen: We have a relentless bias for action and the grit to push through obstacles. We do whatever it takes to figure it out, put in the work, and ruthlessly prioritize the actions that drive measurable impact for the business.
- Own the Outcome: We understand that our responsibility doesn't end when a task is checked off; it ends when the value is delivered. We connect our daily individual actions to the broader success of the company and our customers.
- Create Wow: We measure success by the experience we generate, both inside and outside the company. For our customers, this means impressive speed and intuitive experiences. For our team, this means going the extra mile to support one another and to continuously drive each other to new heights.
- Open Source, Open Mind: We are actively contributing to and maintaining open-source projects. Internally, we foster meritocracy — the strongest ideas win, no matter who or where they come from.
- Build Tomorrow’s Standards, Intentionally: We don't just ship software; we define the state-of-the-art of tomorrow. We are fearless in tearing down old approaches to build something better, but we are disciplined in how we do it because we know our users rely on our technology to run mission-critical infrastructure platforms.

You'll own a product that moves money for Xe's customers in production, define what gets built and when, and serve as the squad's product co-lead with the Team Lead. - 4 to 7 years of product management in fintech, payments, or financial infrastructure.

- Familiarity with design tools such as Figma, and knowledge of UX design best practices.

Every part of the journey — buy/sell, insurance, maintenance, repairs — is fragmented, complicated, and expensive. Jerry.ai is building the first app to manage it all.  

We launched car insurance in 2019 and became one of the top three brokers in the country. We got there in part because we were early on generative AI. Before off-the-shelf platforms existed, we built our own infrastructure to automate sales and service conversations. Today, that system handles a meaningful share of customer interactions end-to-end. The underlying technology is entirely homegrown.  

That head start created real leverage. It also created real complexity. Prompts that power everything from the customer-facing chatbot to vehicle photo validation to back-office automation now live across six separate locations. There is no single source of truth, no unified platform, and no clear owner of where the next big bets — voicebot, computer use, consumer AI applications — belong on the roadmap. **Location:** FDEs and Product to be based in UK / Europe/ Australia  interfacing with AI teams in Vietnam and stakeholders in the US

**Type:** Full-time

**Reporting line:** Head of AI Platforms

**About us**

We're an AI-first builder giving underdog companies a new lease of life with AI. We are launched out of **Chicago Atlantic**, a $3B AUM private credit/debt firm with a top tier fund performance record and deep expertise in AI roll-ups and restructurings. We've spent years inside the deals, and we've seen exactly how much value AI can create for smaller companies that lack the capabilities to compete with larger companies. Now we're building the AI systems to change that: an AI-obsessed team applying frontier AI engineering to the workflows that finance, banking, and restructuring actually run on.

We're small (a ringfenced AI team of 35 and growing), we ship, and we sit close to real capital and real operators. That's the difference between AI that demos well and AI that changes how the work gets done.

For full information, please visit our Notion page: 

https://vireox.notion.site/why-join-us

**What we are building**

Restructuring is one of the highest-stakes, most knowledge-intensive corners of finance, and one of the least touched by modern tooling. We know applied AI works here because we've already done it ourselves: we turnaround underperforming assets from $100M to >$1.1B in annual revenue, applying AI to operations and seeing the gains firsthand, giving capabilities that level the playing field for an ecosystem of smaller companies. 

Now we're pointing that capability at restructuring itself, building the product layer for the work that matters most: diagnosing distressed businesses, valuing assets at scale, and surfacing where value can be unlocked with AI. We've proven the core, and the product itself is ready to grow. If you want to help decide what gets built in a domain with huge upside, this is the place.

**Why this role is for you**

You've done technology inside a finance or consulting environment, and you know how hard it is to launch AI products in a fast-paced professional services setting. You think like a product builder, not just an engineer: you care about what gets used, not just what gets shipped. You want to be on the side that fixes it, building a solution that works with the domain knowledge users already have.

You'll work at the forefront of the stack: harness engineering and plugin-based solutioning, systems deployed against live workflows. You'll have the freedom to define what gets built and the proximity to clients to see your work land in weeks, owning the product decisions as much as the technical ones.

You are looking for ownership, hard problems, and immediate, visible impact. You'll join a nascent team alongside an existing Technical Product Manager, dividing and conquering problems across the entire restructuring process.

**Core responsibilities**

- Lead a team of AI engineers — set direction, unblock execution, grow technical talent, and own team output
- Deploy on the ground — embed with US clients (knowledge workers, operators, finance teams) to diagnose workflows, map real user needs, and translate findings into working systems
- Build 0-to-1 — own the full lifecycle from discovery to shipped product; define what gets built, why, and how it gets measured
- Orchestrate AI systems — design and manage multi-agent workflows and platforms using LLMs; work alongside AI engineers to ship production-grade AI solutions
- Lead professional services transformation — apply AI to the high-value knowledge work that firms run on, from analysis and reporting to restructuring and portfolio monitoring; you'll learn the domain well enough to challenge and redesign it
- Own the product — drive initiative without being directed; set goals, prioritise ruthlessly, and hold the outcome — not just the delivery
- Translate between worlds — speak the language of the business on one side and engineers on the other; you're the connective tissue that stops both sides talking past each other

**Must-haves**

- Forward-deployed experience — you've worked directly inside client environments, not just taken requirements and handed off; you were in a technical role (engineering, data, or systems design) before moving to product
- Knowledge work and professional services experience — you've worked in or alongside professional services, and you understand the kind of complex knowledge work these firms run on
- AI agent and platform management — hands-on experience running AI agents in production: prompt engineering, agent orchestration, platform reliability, and knowing when to rebuild vs. patch
- People leadership — you've led or directly guided technical talent
- 0-to-1 builder track record — you've taken something from ambiguity to working product; you don't wait for requirements to be handed to you
- Strong independent judgment — you operate without hand-holding; you surface blockers, make calls, and move fast in ambiguous environments

**Nice-to-haves**

sample.description:
**Join us as we change healthcare for the better.**

OceanMD, a WELL Health Company, is the leading provider of EMR-integrated Patient Engagement and eReferral tools in Canada, playing a critical role in millions of patient visits and thousands of referrals every week. Our digital healthcare solutions empower patients and physicians to overcome the barriers preventing the timely delivery of healthcare services. By replacing paper forms with digital tools, we give patients and providers secure ways to connect, share health information, and update patient records. Our tools:

- Empower patients to share health information with their physician before, during, and after visits, helping to ensure health records are up-to-date and accurate while improving patient care.
- Meet the growing demand for digital solutions with online booking and secure messaging that improves the patient’s experience, reduces the need for unnecessary phone calls, and makes clinics more efficient.
- Improve access to care by replacing faxes, displaying wait times, and reducing the time to process and access specialist referrals.

**Who we need**

Reporting to the Vice-President, Product & Interoperability, we are hiring a Technical Product Manager, Platform to lead the evolution of the core platform capabilities that power OceanMD's digital health ecosystem. As our new Technical Product Manager, Platform, you will own the shared services and platform features that enable our Patient Engagement and Provider Network solutions, working at the intersection of product strategy, engineering, operations, and platform architecture. You will partner closely with Engineering, UX, Support, Operations, and cross-functional stakeholders to define priorities, translate complex technical and operational needs into clear product requirements, and deliver secure, scalable platform capabilities that improve the experience for providers, administrators, and internal teams alike.

*This is a new, full-time, hybrid role in Toronto requiring work in the office 2-3 days per week. Occasional travel within Canada as needed.*

**What’s in it for you**

Build the foundation behind Canada's leading digital health platform. While many product management roles focus on customer-facing features, this opportunity is also about shaping the platform capabilities that make every OceanMD solution more secure, scalable, reliable, and easier to use. Your work will influence multiple product lines and thousands of healthcare providers across Canada.

Work on meaningful technical challenges. You will collaborate closely with engineering on platform architecture, APIs, security, access management, workflows, integrations, and operational tooling. You'll have the opportunity to solve complex problems, balance competing priorities, and deliver solutions that improve both customer and internal team experiences.

Grow your product leadership. This role offers significant ownership while providing the mentorship and collaboration of an experienced product organization. You'll gain exposure across engineering, operations, implementation, customer support, and leadership while building expertise in healthcare technology, interoperability, and large-scale SaaS platforms.

**How you will make an impact**

- **Own platform capabilities.** You will lead the product lifecycle for shared platform features, including Ocean Portal, site and user administration, provider onboarding, APIs, security workflows, and other foundational services that support multiple OceanMD products.
- **Partner with Engineering.** You will work closely with developers to understand technical constraints, define scalable solutions, clarify system behaviour, and ensure new capabilities are secure, reliable, and built for long-term growth.
- **Translate complexity into clear execution.** You will gather technical, operational, and business requirements and convert them into user stories, workflows, acceptance criteria, release plans, and documentation that enable efficient product delivery.
- **Improve operational experiences.** Working alongside Support, DevOps, Education, and Implementation teams, you will identify opportunities to simplify administration, reduce operational friction, improve onboarding workflows, and enhance the tools internal teams rely on every day.
- **Drive product decisions.** You will prioritize platform initiatives, balancing customer needs, technical debt, security, scalability, operational impact, and business priorities while making thoughtful trade-offs that maximize long-term value.
- **Collaborate across the organization.** You will facilitate discovery sessions, design discussions, stakeholder alignment meetings, testing activities, and release readiness, ensuring teams remain informed and aligned throughout the product development process.

**What you bring**

- The product management experience. You have experience managing software products, technical product initiatives, or complex delivery programs where you owned requirements, prioritization, and cross-functional execution. You are comfortable working across multiple stakeholders while bringing clarity to complex problems.
- The technical curiosity and confidence. You enjoy collaborating with engineers and can confidently participate in discussions involving APIs, system architecture, authentication, integrations, data flows, security, and platform scalability. You don't need to be an engineer, but you are comfortable working in highly technical environments and asking thoughtful questions.
- The operational mindset. You enjoy understanding how products are configured, supported, and used in the real world. You naturally look for opportunities to reduce friction, improve workflows, and create solutions that make life easier for both customers and internal teams.
- The communication skills. You can translate technical concepts into language that different audiences understand, facilitate productive conversations, and build alignment across engineering, operations, leadership, and customer-facing teams.
- The collaborative approach. You build trusted relationships across teams, remain organized while managing multiple priorities, and thrive in environments where success depends on thoughtful collaboration and continuous improvement.

**Nice to have**

Experience working in healthcare technology, SaaS platforms, or enterprise software is considered an asset. Exposure to interoperability standards such as HL7 FHIR, SMART on FHIR, OAuth, identity and access management, or healthcare integrations would also be beneficial.

**Compensation**

The salary range for this position is $90K–$110K. The salary will be determined based on several factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, skills, and the needs of the organization. At OceanMD we are committed to fair and equitable compensation and aim to provide a competitive salary that reflects the value and expertise of the successful candidate.

**What you can expect from our hiring process:**

- A virtual interview with a Talent Advisor discussing your interest in the role and your experience. The conversation will be recorded using BrightHire, an AI-powered video interview tool. More details will be shared when you are invited to interview.
- An in-person interview with the Vice-President, Product & Interoperability and the Director, Product Operations to learn about the role and product strategy. You will be able to share your insights and expertise, and you will have time to ask questions about the company and the role. A simulated ‘client-facing meeting’ exercise may also be included to learn more about how you engage with stakeholders in common scenarios for this role.
- A virtual interview with members of the leadership team. This will be a chance for you to ask questions about the company’s growth trajectory and how you will play a key role as the new Technical Product Manager.

**Our culture, our team**

We’re a scaling company expanding rapidly across the country. We are incredibly passionate about our ability to make a difference in the lives of Canadians through our technology, and we firmly believe that we can do our best work with realistic deadlines and transparent communication about where we are and what’s next for us as an organization. We understand the time it takes to revolutionize a paper-based industry and develop and release high-quality, resilient, compliant, and responsive technology that is easy to use, so we ensure that pace is factored into our projects and deliverables across the organization.

Our focus is your growth and professional satisfaction, resulting in clear opportunities to help us scale and be better through your ideas and the chance to be part of projects and try new things. We are dedicated to our team, and we strongly believe that family comes first.

**A note on values**

We value ethical behaviour above all else. We care about each other, and we respect each other as professionals and people. We treat our customers with respect and keep our word, even if it hurts. We own our mistakes. We strive for honesty and integrity every day in every situation. We look for people who share these values.

**We are transforming patient care across the country, and we’ve only just begun. Join us**

We are always on the lookout for ethically driven, intelligent, and compassionate professionals who want to be part of an energetic culture and company, people who are interested in contributing their talents in a challenging, interdisciplinary environment. If you feel you meet 70% of the qualifications we are looking for and are determined to make a difference, we encourage you to apply. We promise to consider your application fully.

**Express your interest here, explore what we do here, or follow us on LinkedIn to stay connected.**

We strive to build a diverse team and encourage applications from traditionally underrepresented groups. If we can make this easier through accommodation in the recruitment process, please let us know.

This is a highly collaborative role: you will partner directly with our Line of Business (LOB) Product Managers, who own the overarching business vision and customer value proposition. While the LOB PMs define the  *what*  and the  *why*  from a business perspective, you will own the  *how*  , translating their vision into a scalable technical roadmap, managing channel-specific capabilities, and ensuring a high performing digital experience.  

**What You’ll Do**

 **What Could Set You Apart**

**About Us**Sophos is a cybersecurity leader defending 600,000 organizations globally with an AI-driven platform and expert-led services. Sophos meets organizations wherever they are in their security maturity and grows with them to defeat cyberattacks. Its solutions combine machine learning, automation, and real-time threat intelligence with frontline human expertise from Sophos X-Ops to deliver advanced, 24/7 threat monitoring, detection, and response.  

Sophos offers industry-leading managed detection and response (MDR) alongside a comprehensive portfolio of cybersecurity technologies — including endpoint, network, email, and cloud security, extended detection and response (XDR), identity threat detection and response (ITDR), and next-gen SIEM. Together with expert advisory services, these capabilities help organizations proactively reduce risk and respond faster, with the visibility and scalability needed to stay ahead of evolving threats.  

Sophos goes to market with a global partner ecosystem, including Managed Service Providers (MSPs), Managed Security Service Providers (MSSPs), resellers and distributors, marketplace integrations, and cyber risk partners, giving organizations the flexibility to choose trusted relationships when securing their business. Sophos is headquartered in Oxford, U.K. More information is available at www.sophos.com .  

****Role Summary****This role is for individuals with real cybersecurity experience who understand the pressures faced by security teams and the challenges businesses encounter in strengthening their defences. If you've worked in a cybersecurity team, led advisory engagements through a managed service provider, or helped organisations tackle security challenges, this is your chance to apply that expertise on a larger scale.  

As a CISO Advantage Field Specialist, you'll be the key expert for MSP partners seeking genuine knowledge. Instead of relying on slides, you'll leverage your deep understanding of advancing cyber maturity and transformation. Your role includes assisting partners in integrating CISO Advantage into their offerings, empowering their teams to deliver effective security services.  

We seek proactive individuals who thrive at the intersection of technology, people, and business outcomes. If you're excited about helping underserved businesses manage their security risks using leader-edge technology, data and AI as real tools, this role was made for you  

**What You Will Do****Product Feedback & Market Intelligence**

- Operate as a structured, consistent feedback channel between the field and the Sophos Product team, this is a core accountability of the role, not a secondary activity.
- Capture partner and customer feedback on product usability, feature gaps, pricing, and competitive alternatives using agreed formats and cadences set by Product leadership.
- Submit regular regional feedback reports covering adoption blockers, commonly requested features, competitive intelligence, and MSP delivery challenges.

**MSP Partner Enablement**

- Serve as the primary field resource for CISO Advantage MSP partners within your region, the person partners contact when they need product knowledge, positioning support, or help with a customer situation.
- Track partner enablement progress and readiness across your regional MSP portfolio, flagging partners who need additional support and identifying those ready to scale.
- Help partners develop structured onboarding and delivery playbooks so they can consistently deploy CISO Advantage across their customer base.

**End-User Adoption & Training Support**

- Support MSP partners in delivering effective training and onboarding experiences to the end-user organizations they serve, ensuring customers can navigate and use the platform confidently from day one.
- Help channel partners and their customers define what success looks like with CISO Advantage, establishing clear use cases, adoption milestones, and outcome metrics from the outset.
- Provide partners with end-user-facing guidance materials, FAQs, and best-practice documentation they can adapt and deliver to their customers.
- Act as an escalation resource for partners encountering complex end-user adoption challenges, working collaboratively to resolve issues and improve the customer experience.
- Gather and document customer adoption stories, use cases, and outcomes that can be used for MSP enablement, product marketing, and internal reporting.

**Cross-Function Collaboration**

- Work closely with regional Sales and Channel teams to align enablement activity with commercial priorities and partner tier.
- Collaborate with Product Marketing to validate regional messaging and surface localization requirements, language, regulatory context, or market-specific positioning needs.
- Partner with the Product and Customer Success teams to ensure end-user training content remains current and aligned with platform updates and new feature releases.

**What You Will Bring**

- 5–8 years of experience in a cybersecurity-related role, this could include technical pre-sales, partner success, channel enablement, security consulting, or a vendor-side field role.
- Experience working with or within an MSP, channel partner, or VAR environment, understanding how managed service businesses operate and how they engage their customers.
- Exposure to security programme management, GRC, or vCISO service delivery, either from the customer, MSP, or vendor side.
- Experience in a product feedback, customer success, or voice-of-customer role within a B2B SaaS or security vendor environment.
- Demonstrated experience supporting end-user training, onboarding, or adoption programmes, either directly or through channel partners.

**Knowledge & Skills**

- Working knowledge of cybersecurity concepts, terminology, and the challenges faced by security teams in mid-market and enterprise organizations.
- Ability to translate complex security and platform concepts into clear, accessible guidance for both MSP partners and their end-user customers.
- Strong communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to operate effectively across technical, commercial, and customer-facing contexts.
- Comfort working in a structured feedback environment, capturing insights methodically and communicating them clearly to product and leadership teams.
- A genuine personal and professional interest in AI, we operate an AI-first strategy and expect this person to be an AI native. You should actively use AI tools in your day-to-day work, stay current with developments in the space, and bring both curiosity and practical knowledge of how AI can be applied to security, enablement, and customer success.

In Canada, the base salary for this role ranges from $134,000 to $223,000. In addition to base salary, we offer additional compensation including bonus eligibility and a comprehensive benefits package.  A candidate’s specific pay within this range will depend on a variety of factors, including job- related skills, training, location, experience, relevant education, certifications, and other business and organizational needs.

**Who are we?**Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.  

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.  

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.  

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!  

**About Cohere And North**Cohere is revolutionizing enterprise AI with North, an agentic AI platform designed to securely deploy AI agents and automations within organizations' infrastructure. North empowers employees to streamline workflows, automate repetitive tasks, and unlock actionable insights while ensuring data privacy and compliance. North combines cutting-edge generative and search models with customizable integrations to drive productivity and innovation at scale.  

**Role Overview**We are seeking an Agent Harness Product Manager to own the execution layer that makes North agents reliable, capable, and production-ready. This is a role that sits at the intersection of three domains:  

**Agent Loop and Execution.**Own the core agent runtime: tool orchestration, parallel execution, sub-agent delegation, sandbox code execution, and failure recovery. You will define how North agents plan and act across long, multi-step workflows and ensure the execution environment is robust enough for the most demanding enterprise tasks. You are expected to engage at the implementation level, contributing to architecture decisions alongside engineering rather than simply handing off requirements.  

**Context Engineering.**Own how our Agents manage the context window as a deliberately controlled resource. This includes progressive disclosure of tools and skills, context compaction and summarization, offloading of large payloads to a persistent filesystem, and the instrumentation that keeps agents oriented across extended trajectories.  

**Model-Scaffolding Co-evolution.**Own the feedback loop between North's harness and the Modeling Team. This PM is the connective tissue that makes that possible: ensuring harness design decisions are validated by Modeling before they are built, that evals are the shared bridge between both teams, and that as the harness evolves the model evolves with it.  

**Responsibilities**

- Define and own the roadmap for North's agent harness, including the agent loop, context engineering layer, tool orchestration, sandbox execution, and sub-agent delegation
- Serve as the primary interface between North engineering and Cohere's Modeling team, ensuring new harness capabilities are validated before being built and that neither team paints itself into a corner
- Own North's agentic evaluation framework, ensuring evals are compatible with both the North harness and Modeling's training infrastructure, and that they serve as a reliable bridge between product and research
- Engage enterprise customers to surface real-world agentic failures and translate findings into concrete product and model requirements
- Partner with the agentic expert modeling team to define goals that maximize the impact of our models and prioritize model capabilities and evals most critical for delivering on those goals. Establish a clear roadmap for our agentic modeling capabilities.
- Stay current with the open-source and commercial agent ecosystem and drive adoption decisions that keep North's architecture aligned with emerging standards.

**Requirements**

- 5+ years of product management experience as a research PM, in agentic AI systems,, or applied ML products
- Deep understanding of agentic harnesses, including the latest paid and open source offerings.
- Deep understanding of modern LLM agent architectures, including multi-agent systems, tool-augmented reasoning, memory and retrieval, programmatic orchestration, RAG, and long-horizon execution
- Strong grasp of agentic evaluation design, including how to measure task completion, failure recovery, and long-horizon reliability, and how to diagnose model vs. scaffolding gaps
- Technically deep enough to contribute to architecture decisions at the implementation level: comfortable reviewing and shaping design docs, reasoning about async execution patterns, sandboxed environments, filesystem design, and the tradeoffs that come with building harness capabilities into a production platform
- Ability to flex between ML research conversations and engineering architecture discussions with equal fluency
- Track record of shipping platform-layer products with demonstrated impact on reliability, performance, or capability.

**Nice-to-Haves**

- Direct experience in developing and shipping leading agentic harnesses.
- An active practitioner of agent frameworks who regularly builds with and follows the latest developments in open-source harnesses, coding agents, and orchestration tools in both professional and personal work
- Hands-on experience with enterprise agentic deployments: multi-tenant orchestration, tool permissioning, audit trails, and compliance requirements
- Familiarity with infrastructure constraints relevant to enterprise deployments: on-premises environments, scalability challenges, and the operational tradeoffs of running complex agent workloads in restricted or air-gapped settings
- Prior work at the intersection of research and product, translating nascent model capabilities into shipped product features
- Background working within or closely alongside an ML research or post-training team.

**Why Join Cohere?**

- Impact: Shape how Canada's most important public institutions adopt and deploy frontier AI.
- Innovation: Work alongside leading researchers and engineers solving complex ML challenges.
- Growth: Competitive compensation, equity options, and opportunities for professional development.
- Flexibility: Hybrid work model with offices in key global locations (Toronto, Montreal, New York, San Francisco, London, Paris, and Korea)

**Full-Time Employees At Cohere Enjoy These Perks**

- A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch.
- Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health.
- RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme.
- 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent.
- Annual enrichment benefits:

Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit.  

Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching.  

- 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!)
- Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite.

**How And Where We Work**

- Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon.
- For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events.
- For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city.
- Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly.

If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply.  

We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form, and we will work together to meet your needs.

Fitch Ratings is currently seeking a Delivery Practice Owner, based out of our Toronto, Canada office.  

**About The Team**You will join the Delivery Management track within Technology & Data Delivery Enablement, leading Agile squad(s) to enable predictable, high-quality delivery. As a senior practitioner, you will partner with Tribe Leads, Technical Owners, Product, Engineering, Data, Finance, and business sponsors to evolve ways of working, mentor Delivery Owners, and contribute to enterprise delivery standards through our Communities of Practice.

- Enable delivery outcomes for your squad, ensuring predictable execution and high-quality delivery.
- Ensure the definition of ready/done and release criteria are consistently applied.
- Maintain squad-level accountability, modeling best practices within your assigned squad.
- Ensure the squad meets delivery commitments; drive predictability, throughput, and quality metrics.
- Facilitate strategic decisions and trade-offs with colleagues and senior leadership.
- Create transparency in delivery health; provide honest assessments and escalate risks with options and solutions.
- Mentor Delivery Owners through coaching and Agile leadership.

AI Enablement and Modern Practices  

- Drive adoption of AI-enabled delivery practices; mentor Delivery Owners on AI tool utilization.
- Identify and pilot new AI capabilities; share learnings with the Agile Delivery Center of Excellence.
- Champion AI literacy and responsible AI use within delivery management.
- Share learnings with peers and contribute to delivery practice evolution.

Operating Model and Enablement  

- Enable squad-level delivery rituals, escalation protocols, and forums rooted in Agile principles.
- Drive evidence-based planning and forecasting at the squad level.
- Keep roadmaps, backlogs, capacity plans, and forecasts synchronized and actionable.
- Lead retrospectives that identify systemic improvements; drive cross-squad improvement initiatives.
- Model accountability by owning delivery outcomes and transparently communicating status and risks.

Continuous Improvement and Evolution  

- Coach squad members on flow, predictability, and metrics; leverage modern practices to accelerate delivery.
- Foster a culture of experimentation and continuous improvement.

Center of Excellence Contribution  

- Lead initiatives within the Agile Delivery Center of Excellence.
- Develop delivery standards, playbooks, and best practices.
- Share innovations across the organization.
- Contribute to training programs and capability-building initiatives.

**You May Be a Good Fit If**

- You hold a bachelor’s degree in Business, Technology, or a related field, or have equivalent experience.
- You have 6–8 years in Agile delivery, including 3+ years as a Delivery Owner or Scrum Master, with a proven track record delivering complex initiatives with measurable outcomes.
- You maintain Certified Scrum Master (CSM) and Certified Scrum Professional (CSP) or equivalent certifications.
- You demonstrate strong executive communication, stakeholder management, and experience mentoring delivery practitioners.

**What Would Make You Stand Out**

- Multiple advanced Agile certifications (e.g., CSP, SAFe, Kanban) and experience leading delivery transformation or AI enablement initiatives.
- Background in establishing delivery standards, playbooks, and Communities of Practice.
- Experience in financial services or regulated industries.

**Why Choose Fitch**

- A Culture of Learning & Mobility: Dedicated trainings, leadership development and mentorship programs designed to ensure that your time at Fitch will be a continuous learning opportunity.
- Investing in Your Future: Retirement planning and tuition reimbursement programs that empower you to achieve your short and long-term goals.
- Promoting Health & Wellbeing: Comprehensive healthcare offerings that enable physical, mental, financial, social, and occupational wellbeing.
- Supportive Parenting Policies: Family-friendly policies, including a generous global parental leave plan, designed to help you balance career and family life effectively.
- Inclusive Work Environment: A collaborative workplace where all voices are valued, with Employee Resource Groups that unite and empower our colleagues around the globe.

À propos de Highspring

Highspring est une firme de services-conseils et de services professionnels de nouvelle génération. Nous accompagnons les organisations dans leurs initiatives stratégiques en transformation numérique, cybersécurité, données, assurance qualité et modernisation technologique. Grâce à une approche agile, collaborative et orientée vers les résultats, nous aidons nos clients à relever leurs défis les plus complexes tout en générant un impact d'affaires durable.

L'opportunité

Highspring est à la recherche d'un(e) **Scrum Master** expérimenté(e) pour soutenir ses clients dans l'adoption, l'évolution et l'optimisation de leurs pratiques Agile.

À titre de consultant(e), vous travaillerez étroitement avec des équipes multidisciplinaires, des Product Owners et diverses parties prenantes afin de favoriser une livraison efficace de produits et de projets tout en contribuant à l'amélioration continue des équipes et des processus organisationnels.

Vous jouerez également un rôle important dans les initiatives de transformation Agile et dans le développement d'une culture de collaboration, de transparence et d'excellence opérationnelle.

- Animer les cérémonies Agile, notamment les Sprint Planning, Daily Stand-ups, Sprint Reviews et Rétrospectives.
- Accompagner les équipes dans l'application des principes, valeurs et pratiques Agile.
- Soutenir les Product Owners dans la gestion, l'organisation et la priorisation du backlog.
- Assurer le suivi des livrables, des engagements de sprint et des indicateurs de performance de l'équipe.
- Identifier, documenter et aider à résoudre les obstacles, risques et dépendances pouvant affecter la livraison.
- Favoriser une collaboration efficace entre les équipes de livraison, les gestionnaires et les parties prenantes.
- Animer des ateliers de travail, des séances de planification et des activités d'amélioration continue.
- Conseiller les clients sur les meilleures pratiques Agile et les approches de livraison adaptées à leur contexte.
- Participer aux initiatives de transformation organisationnelle et à l'amélioration de la maturité Agile.
- Préparer et présenter des rapports d'avancement aux différentes parties prenantes.
- Agir comme agent de changement en promouvant une culture axée sur la collaboration, la transparence et l'amélioration continue.
- Développer et maintenir des relations de confiance avec les clients et les équipes de projet.

Ce que vous apportez à la table

- Minimum de 4 années d'expérience à titre de Scrum Master.
- Expérience démontrée dans des environnements Agile complexes.
- Expérience en services-conseils ou en services professionnels auprès de clients externes.
- Excellentes aptitudes de communication, d'animation et de facilitation.
- Capacité reconnue à influencer, mobiliser et accompagner des équipes multidisciplinaires.
- Forte orientation client et excellentes habiletés relationnelles.
- Bilinguisme français et anglais, tant à l'oral qu'à l'écrit.

Compétences clés requises

- Excellente maîtrise des cadres Scrum, Kanban et des principes Agile.
- Expérience avec les outils Jira, Confluence et/ou Azure DevOps.
- Capacité à suivre et analyser les indicateurs de performance Agile.
- Expérience dans la gestion des risques, dépendances et enjeux de livraison.
- Solides compétences en coaching Agile et en amélioration continue.
- Aptitude à évoluer dans des environnements dynamiques et à forte visibilité.
- Bilinguisme requis ( angalis/ français)

Notre environnement

- Méthodologies Agile : Scrum, Kanban et pratiques Agile à grande échelle.
- Outils de gestion : Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps.
- Collaboration avec des équipes multidisciplinaires dans des contextes de transformation numérique.
- Participation à des initiatives stratégiques de modernisation technologique et d'amélioration des processus.

Pourquoi joindre Highspring?

- Collaborer avec une équipe dynamique de consultants et d'experts de haut calibre.
- Participer à des projets stratégiques et à fort impact pour des organisations de premier plan.
- Profiter d'occasions de formation continue, de perfectionnement professionnel et de certifications.
- Évoluer dans une culture collaborative qui valorise l'innovation, l'agilité et le leadership.
- Bénéficier d'un environnement de travail flexible favorisant l'équilibre entre la vie professionnelle et personnelle.

limitations: Coding was model-assisted independent single coding, not human double coding; no inter-rater reliability or human adjudication is available.
Stored current filter_status and filter_reason are operational state, not ground-truth labels; the filtered guard itself found false exclusions.
Strata overlap: 325 draws represent 307 unique lane/job IDs. Do not pool strata as independent observations.

Wilson 95% intervals are per-stratum binomial intervals for relevant plus borderline among decided labels; insufficient labels are excluded, finite-population correction and coding error are not modeled.
Sole-query yields are descriptive marginal samples, not causal query estimates; query associations are non-exclusive. No query removal is recommended.

The snapshot covers LinkedIn Canada memberships present in the frozen population and active-query provenance observed at or after revision 9; it does not estimate other providers, geographies, missing listings, or future drift.
Complete title exclusion match sets were replayed on the supplied 8,348-row population. Most large match sets received deterministic recall samples rather than exhaustive relevance coding.

The stored technology candidate pattern-1 match-set artifact has 118 rows, while replay on the supplied later 8,348-row population has 119 due to one added title, Technical Product Manager - GenAI Programmes. Both snapshots are retained rather than silently reconciled.
The revision-5 rollback identifier is recovered, but its configuration body is absent from the supplied evidence.
Prior-audit label rows do not contain rationales; these are marked not_present_in_prior_source rather than reconstructed or invented.
The backfill artifact is a dry run: applied_count is 0. Production state may drift after the snapshot.
